identity.title: [v0.91.8][tooling][lockfile] Prevent validation and binary installation from rewriting tracked Cargo.lock files

values.task_boundary: Use current targets, --locked, and exact pre-invocation byte restoration for invocation-created drift.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Removed target failure leaves Cargo.lock byte-identical
AC-2: Dependency-resolution drift is restored fail-closed
AC-3: Pre-existing user-owned lock changes remain byte-identical
AC-5: Default owner inventory contains only current Cargo targets
